text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Tributes paid on the third anniversary of the death of President Hafez al-Assad's eldest son Bassel.
- Assad congratulates U.S. President Bill Clinton and stresses need for work for just and comprehensive peace.
- Arab League urges U.S. to take fair stand on Middle East peace.
- France welcomes Europe's role in Middle East peace process.
- Israel plans more settlements in the occupied Golan and our Syrian people in the Golan foil an attempt to confiscate lands in the village of Masaada.
- Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu renews his call for unconditional talks and rejects commitment to withdrawal from the Golan.
- China calls for the implementation of land for peace principle in the Middle East peace process.
- Egypt urges Israel to join the nuclear nonproliferation treaty and says peace talks with Syria should start from the point at which they stopped.
- King Fahd affirms Saudi support to just peace on all tracks.
- Arab and international media continue condemnation of the U.S. position which is biased in favour of Israel concerning the arms deal between Syria and South Africa.
- Assad issues a decree appointing a new head for the committee of observation and inspection of government offices.
